address: 80/1 Rahaeng Market, Rahaeng, Lat Lum Kaeo, Pathum Thani, 12140, Thailand
bio: This hidden eatery in the 100-year-old Rahaeng Market has been serving traditional Thai-Chinese dishes for over 50 years. With a focus on quality ingredients from the market, their homemade dishes like minced featherback fish and pork in tofu sheets are recommended. Arrive early for spicy stir-fried featherback fish and fried sun-dried snakehead fish....
